entry.title: Manage records
entry.description: Add members, charges, payments, expenses and Sunday duties.
entry.newCharge: Assign dues or fine to a member
entry.label: Label
entry.allocationHelp: Payments are applied to the oldest outstanding charges first. Any remainder stays unallocated cash.
entry.voidHelp: Void a mistaken charge, payment or expense. The record stays in the audit trail.
entry.generateHelp: Assigns active members in turn and skips dates already scheduled.
entry.saveError: Could not save. Check the fields and related records, then try again.
entry.demoNotice: This is a read-only preview with fictional records. Connect Postgres to enable the forms below.
entry.deleteMemberHelp: A member with charges, payments, or duties cannot be deleted. Deactivate them instead.
entry.statusHelp: Payment status is calculated from recorded payments and due dates. Change a charge or payment to update it.
entry.deleteLookupHelp: Only unused categories and fine reasons can be deleted. Deactivate a fine reason that has history.
entry.confirmDelete: Are you sure? This action changes the association records.
entry.reassignHelp: You can change the assigned member only before a payment is linked to this charge.
